$comment: What a new repository starts with. Read by bin/new-repo.sh, checked against blueprint/files/, workflow-templates/ and sync.json by bin/bootstrap-parity.mjs, so a starter or a template cannot be added and forgotten. `from` is a path in this repository, `to` the path in the new one. `substitute` lists the placeholder words replaced by the repository name; any other {placeholder} is left for a person. Templates are rendered as the template sync renders them (site, flags, default branch). `requires` makes an entry conditional: `kind` (--kind, which is needed unless blueprint/release.json exempts the repository, or the release items report drift) or a declared option. A starter with `perKind` has KIND in its `from`, replaced by the kind. A starter or template that is not bootstrapped is in `excluded` with the reason. `replace` maps a literal text to its value (a new repository has no release history to skip, and starts at version 0.0.0). A template with `unlessScaffold` is left out when the groundwork scaffold ran, because its own ci.yml already defines that check; on any other path the scaffold wrote, the scaffold wins and the file is not overwritten. `requires: public` is on unless --private: Scorecard cannot check out a private repository, and Dependency Review needs a public one or Code Security. `todo` is a line the script prints at the end for a person. `orgSecrets` are organization secrets the new repository must be shared (a private repository gets none by default; the release secrets come from blueprint/release.json when a kind is given), and a kind also turns on immutable releases, which the release workflow needs. `requires` may be negated with `!` (`!docs`): two entries may write the same path only when their conditions are opposites. In a `replace` value, `{repo}`, `{site}`, `{host}`, `{subdomain}` and `{date}` stand for the repository, its site URL, the site's host, the first label of that host (all from projects.json) and today's date as YYYY-MM-DD. `orgSecrets` entries are a name or {name, requires}. `todos` are lines printed at the end for a person, with the same tokens. With the docs option the script also vendors the design (bin/sync-design.sh of the pinned m3l-design release), copies the reviewed deploy lockfile and proves it with npm ci --dry-run, runs the docs gate on the result before anything is created, and creates the docs-cloudflare environment.
